questions.q: Why is migrating from a Zebra to a BV420D low-risk for the customer?
o: ZPL II emulation means existing label templates and BarTender workflow carry across
Zebra and Toshiba use identical part numbers
questions.e: ZPL II emulation plus the same BarTender design workflow makes it a driver reinstall and config step, not a workflow rebuild.

questions.q: What is the BV420D's max direct-thermal print speed at 203 dpi?
questions.e: The BV420D runs 7 ips at 203 dpi versus the Zebra ZD421's 6 ips — about 17% faster.

questions.q: Which interface ships as standard on the BV420D but is a paid option on the Zebra ZD421?
questions.e: Every BV420D includes USB plus 10/100 Ethernet as standard; on the ZD421 Ethernet is a paid extra.
